name: command-search
title: Command Search
description: Click or press ⌘/Ctrl + K to expand the search field.
useCases: In a documentation hub, a developer presses Ctrl/⌘+K, enters a phrase and opens the results page through the app handler.
In a compact project toolbar, a user expands a button into a field and searches for a file using free text.
task: Submit a free-text query to application search.
behavior: onSearch receives the query string. The app supplies the route and results. Pass shortcut={false} if the app already handles Ctrl/⌘+K.
